io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils

Class ParticleCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.ParticleCompat

  • public final class ParticleCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe particle spawning. World#spawnParticle and the whole org.bukkit.Particle enum were added in Minecraft 1.9, so a direct bytecode reference throws NoClassDefFoundError / NoSuchMethodError at class-load on 1.8.8. Everything here is resolved reflectively; when the API is unavailable the (purely cosmetic) particle is silently skipped.
